answer: work that cannot be parallelized from one seed. Forking an identity into copies forces an attacker to split its single chain into divergent branches, and validators accept only the canonical branch by majority attestation, so duplicates carry zero inherited trust. Cost to an attacker: they must burn real compute and stake on every branch while gaining nothing, since each forged copy starts from zero reputation, making fake identities economically worthless compared to honest cumulative work, like water carving one canyon through rock instead of scattering like saffron threads across an ocean
